senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = שנטה, Egypt. שנט, v. Ges. Thes. s. v. שנט) acacia.
units: R. Hash. 23ᵃ (as a species of cedar), expl. תּוֹרָנִיתָא; B. Bath. 80ᵇ שיטא (corr. acc.). R. Hash. l. c. כל ש׳ וש׳ שנטלו וכ׳ the Lord shall cause every acacia tree that the gentiles have taken from Jerusalem to be restored to her. Tanḥ. T’rum. 9 כל ארון … ארז של ש׳ בו in every ark (for the Torah scrolls) that Israelites make, they must put shiṭṭah-cedar. Ib. ומכולן … הש׳ בלבד and of all these (species of cedars) only the acacia was chosen (for the Tabernacle); a. e.—Trnsf. the holy Ark.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24a">Ab. Zar. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54">Gen. R. s. 54</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00374"><he>רוּם</he></cite> I h.; Midr. Sam. ch. XII.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54">Ib.</cite> <he>היו … כלפי ש׳ וכ׳</he> (Gen. R. l. c. <he>הארון</he>) the cows turned their faces towards the Ark, and recited songs.—Pl. <cite ref="U00753"><he>שִׁיטִּים</he></cite>, <he>שִׁטּ׳</he>. Tanḥ. l. c. <he>ומתרפאין בש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00753"><he>שִׁטִּים</he></cite>. Ib. <he>אמר … אני מרפא את הש׳</he> the Lord said, in the future I shall heal (restore) the acacias (ref. to <cite ref="Joel 4:18">Joel IV, 18</cite>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="U00753"><he>שִׁטִּים</he></cite>.
